echo "---"

# 拷到临时目录再启动，避免从只读 DMG 跑

cp -R "$MOUNT/InspireX.app" /tmp/InspireX.app
hdiutil detach "$MOUNT" -quiet
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /tmp/InspireX.app 2>/dev/null || true
echo "copied /tmp/InspireX.app"
file /tmp/InspireX.app/Contents/MacOS/inspirex
ls -lh /tmp/InspireX.app/Contents/MacOS/inspirex

```bash
# 启动封装 App，确认本机可运行
lsof -tiTCP:18765 | xargs kill 2>/dev/null || true
open /tmp/InspireX.app
ok=0
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  if curl -sf --max-time 1 http://127.0.0.1:18765/health >/dev/null; then
    ok=1
    break
  fi
  sleep 1
done
if [[ "$ok" -eq 1 ]]; then
  echo "LAUNCH_OK $(curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:18765/health)"
  pgrep -lf "InspireX.app/Contents/MacOS/inspirex" || true
else
  echo "LAUNCH_FAIL after 30s"
  log show --predicate 'process == "inspirex"' --last 1m 2>/dev/null | tail -20 || true
fi
```
